description: ai-eva is a multi-surface AI application platform that normalizes user interactions from web, LINE, Discord, and IoT devices into structured envelopes for centralized dispatching. The system couples LLM tool-calling and copilot workflows with dynamic device capability mapping, external data adapters, and modular domain handlers.

components.name: Interaction Surfaces
components.description: Exposes external interaction surfaces including LINE messaging, Discord voice, device HTTP endpoints, queue listeners, and SSO handoffs.

components.name: Domain Modules
components.description: Executes domain business operations for charts, project management, and sustainability impact calculation via a module registry.

components.name: Chat Applications
components.description: Implements distinct chat application modes and exposes registry metadata for user-facing interactive workflows.

components.name: Core AI Services
components.description: Provides foundational AI orchestration, model generation, opencode sessions, search, and local storage capabilities.

components.name: Application Host and Dispatch
components.description: Orchestrates the application lifecycle, normalizes multi-channel messages into envelopes, and coordinates project-scoped dispatching.

components.name: Data Source Adapters
components.description: Abstracts data access through CMS, mock stub, and generic data source adapter interfaces.

components.name: Build Tooling and Static Assets
components.description: Houses architecture diagram generation scripts and browser static assets.

components.name: Device Node Management
components.description: Manages edge device node registrations, capability tracking, and outbound command dispatch queues.

components.name: Tool Runtime and Registry
components.description: Maintains tool schemas mapped to device capabilities and executes dynamic tool runtime invocations.

key_edges.description: Device surfaces register nodes, report heartbeats, and pull queued execution commands.
SSO sessions initialize and inspect the tool runtime for visible tool definitions.
Domain handlers query and update data through underlying data source adapters.
Analysis applications invoke domain calculation modules via the module registry.
Interactive chat applications invoke language models and web search services.
Applications instantiate data source adapters to supply contextual records.
Application handlers execute tools dynamically within the runtime environment.
Copilot workflows invoke sustainability and domain calculation modules.
Copilot context builders instantiate CMS adapters for external system interaction.
Application startup initializes surface-specific database tables.
Main message loop resolves and activates enabled chat applications.
Dispatcher and message handlers execute copilot loops and LLM completions.
Dispatcher inspects node registry for capabilities and translates intents to commands.
Dispatcher maps node capabilities to tool schemas for LLM function-calling.
CMS adapter queries trigger registered tool invocations inside the tool runtime.
